title: Serp Sleeves
text: These are crafted by getting a full set of your class' from the dungeon Serpentis in Exeloch and combining them into a single piece that goes in your arm slot. You can find the item's in the folio by searching their names or by navigating to Zones -> Warrior Armor: Shadow Warrior's Shadows (Cloth) Dark Warrior's Guards (Leather) Crimson Warrior Vambraces (Plate)
